entwurf.thema: Claude Projects: what free covers and what paying adds

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Picture a workspace that keeps your files together. Claude Projects offers that, and free accounts can use it.
teile.szene: Painted urban open-world-game poster style: black-haired man in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sorts stacks of files at a late-night desk, medium shot, neon city window glow behind him.

teile.name: Workspace
teile.text: A project is a self-contained workspace with its own chats and knowledge base. Upload documents, then chat with context.
teile.szene: Official Claude Help Center page on projects shown prominently, close-up of the opening description of workspaces, chat histories and knowledge bases.

teile.name: Instructions
teile.text: You can also write project instructions, like asking for a formal tone or answers from a specific role.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game style: the cyan-glasses presenter in leather jacket types thoughtfully at a laptop in a cozy loft, over-the-shoulder medium shot, warm lamp light, no readable screen.

teile.name: Free limit
teile.text: So what's the catch on free? You can create a maximum of five projects. Paying adds something else.
teile.szene: Help Center page section stating that projects are available to free accounts with a maximum of five, cropped large and centered.

teile.name: RAG
teile.text: Paid plans get RAG mode. When project knowledge nears context limits, Claude expands capacity by up to 10x.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game style: the cyan-glasses presenter faces a towering wall of filing boxes in a dim archive and looks amazed, wide shot, cyan accent light.

teile.name: Payoff
teile.text: That workspace is more than storage: Claude uses your files as context in each chat inside. Start free, but check Claude's pricing before paying.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game style: the cyan-glasses presenter leans back relaxed with a satisfied smile in a bright city apartment, tidy files stacked beside him, medium shot, soft morning light.

teile.name: Abschluss
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket gives a friendly nod in a neon-lit street, medium shot, calm space above and below.

entwurf.beschreibung: Claude Projects give you a workspace with its own chats, documents and instructions. Per Claude's help page, free users get up to five projects; paid plans add RAG mode.
